title: FLUX.3 Block Offload 最小参数量

standard.summary: 低于该参数量的 block 不参与 CPU/GPU 换入。默认 50 MB。
standard.effect: 设置 FLUX.3 block offload 的最小参数量阈值。
standard.whenToUse: 通常保持默认；仅在小 block 的换入开销明显时调整。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要为了省少量显存而频繁换入很小的 block。

standard_en.summary: Blocks below this parameter-size threshold are not transferred between CPU and GPU. Default: 50 MB.
standard_en.effect: Sets the minimum FLUX.3 block size eligible for offloading.
standard_en.whenToUse: Usually keep the default; adjust only when transfers of small blocks are a clear cost.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Avoid frequent transfers of tiny blocks to save only a small amount of VRAM.
